resources.string: Changing the screen orientation is the same as normal; just rotate the device. \n\n If you want to change your own orientation (eg. lie on your side), open the notification for this app to adjust the screen orientation accordingly.
If you want to uninstall this app, please first disable its "Enabled" setting to ensure the screen doesn\'t get stuck in the wrong orientation. This is necessary because of an Android limitation.
Rotate the device until the image is aligned with your head. Then wait for a vibration.
